content:

urlText: Ferries will be busy during Vivid Sydney
content:
Ferry passengers are advised to expect delays and long queues for ferries to and from the city during Vivid Sydney from Friday 23 May to Saturday 14 June.
  • Services will be busy and are expected to reach capacity from mid-afternoon, particularly on weekends.
  • Some additional F3 and F4 ferries will run on weeknights and weekends during the event.
  • Vivid Sydney attendees planning to catch a ferry to precincts around Circular Quay, Barangaroo or Pyrmont should plan ahead and have a back-up transport option in mind, from most wharves you can catch buses to the city or to nearby train stations to connect with services to the city.
